svg.title: TOPAK G3 — Theorem to premise: what every checked or proved property rests on, and what is void at the reference
svg.desc: spec/theorem-premise-binding.md (2026.09.30, revised 2026.10.01, 2026.10.02 with ADR-0046, 2026.10.02 for the launcher, "pending" ADR-0033 A7, and 2026.10.06 with ADR-0053's derived premises; DRAFT, revised with the records it binds) is the table ADR-0045 §3 owes and ADR-0023 §2 assumes: one row per checked property, naming the trusted-base rows (ADR-0045 Annex A), the degeneracy parameters (ADR-0023 §6a) and the declared gaps it rests on. A property holds for a deployment when every row it names is declared delegated or trust root, every parameter holds and no gap premise is false; otherwise it is void. 38 of its 43 rows name a proof module, 15 modules in all; at G12 twelve of those certify and three do not, and nineteen of the thirty-four proof modules have no row: the eight G11 item 90 named behind the records in force (G12 item 90, open), Correlator, whose record is Proposed, and the ten proof modules of Proposed records since G11: Workflow and Mesh, proved 2026.11.11 (ADR-0054 R7, ADR-0055 R3; item 101), and the command-chain overlay's eight (ADR-0059 to ADR-0066 R1; item 112). Where a record moved and the table did not (A7, B29; ADR-0034 A2 and ADR-0042 §6, B30), the verdict is drawn as the table states it and marked. Drawn four ways: the gap, the key chains as a DAG, the full incidence matrix, and the table itself, all 43 rows. spec/theorem-premise-binding.json carries the same table as a Boolean matrix and spec/inventory.py --check fails when the two disagree; this diagram reads the Markdown.

A property holds

for a deployment when every row it names is declared delegated or trust root, every parameter holds and no gap premise is false; otherwise it is void. 38 of its 43 rows name a proof module, 15 modules in all; at G12 twelve of those certify and three do not, and nineteen of the thirty-four proof modules have no row: the eight G11 item 90 named behind the records in force (G12 item 90, open), Correlator, whose record is Proposed, and the ten proof modules of Proposed records

since G11: Workflow and Mesh, proved 2026.11.11 (ADR-0054 R7, ADR-0055 R3; item 101), and the command-chain overlay's eight (ADR-0059 to ADR-0066 R1; item 112). Where a record moved and the table did not (A7, B29; ADR-0034 A2 and ADR-0042 §6, B30), the verdict is drawn as the table states it and marked. Drawn four ways: the gap, the key chains as a DAG, the full incidence matrix, and the table itself, all 43 rows. spec/theorem-premise-binding.json carries the same
table as a Boolean matrix and spec/inventory.py --check fails when the two disagree; this diagram reads the Markdown.

svg.text: One row per checked property: what it assumed. A property is void for a deployment when a row it names is excluded,
undeclared (ADR-0045 §3 rule 1) or refused, or a parameter or gap premise is false.
The last column computes ADR-0023 §2's inventory for the reference against ADR-0045 Annex B.
Since B25 the Checked in column names the proof module beside the base module (ADR-0046 §5); 38 rows name one.
The file's words: "A proof by itself. Every property here was checked by TLC at small constants, or restated as a test, by the
same hands that wrote the records, and the invariants of thirty-seven rows are also proved" by the proof module the Checked
in column cites, by the same hands.
A row says what a check or a proof assumed; it strengthens neither. Proved is of the module and under named hypotheses
(ADR-0046 §1); neither method claims anything of the running reference (T-0045-28).
T-0045-1 replicas apply the ordered log as crash-fault machines; T-0045-11 the records are the ratified records; T-0045-29
TLC at the constants run; T-0045-30 the build toolchain.
T-0045-28: the running code refines the specification. No refinement exists, so for a running deployment every property is
conditional on this row.
A row with a proof module (B25): the invariant rests on T-0045-31, the prover, in place of T-0045-29, for every constant the
proof's assumptions admit; the mutations and witnesses rest on T-0045-29 as before.

text.tspan: Status of the table and its records

svg.text: ADR-0045 is Accepted (genesis), confirmation required C2, C4 (Batch 22, R6 added the table). ADR-0046 revised it in place
(Batch 25, 2026.10.02; C2, C4): the proof column and five corrections.
The table itself is a DRAFT, revised with the records it binds; its versioning belongs to the archetype-evolution record, still
unwritten (G11 item 7). Its rows were last revised 2026.10.02, "pending" ADR-0033 A7; A7 and ADR-0034 A2 have been
ratified since (B29, B30) and the rows were not revised; Batch 36 added derived premises and changed no row's verdict
(G11 §2.6, item 90). Never… witnesses are not theorems and are omitted.

text.tspan: 0 · What the table covers at G12, and what it does not: thirty-four proof modules, every one proved, fifteen bound, twelve of those certified; nineteen with no row, ten under Proposed records

svg.text: G11 item 90: "The binding table has no rows for Labels, ToolList, Operators, Emergency, BreakGlass_A1 or NonComposition_A1, nor now for Emergency_live, Coupling_live, Workflow or Mesh." G12 item 90: "eighteen modules have no binding rows, now with the overlay's eight"; it also names RulesFloorBase.tla. Workflow and Mesh are proved since 2026.11.11 and the overlay's eight since 2026.11.10, every one under a Proposed record (G12 §2.9, items 101, 112). Certification is ADR-0046 A1's (Batch 28):

every obligation closed by the prover's normalization, an SMT proof the ethos checker accepted, a Zenon proof Isabelle checked, or an LS4 temporal step no checker confirms (spec/proof-certification.md §2, §9; G10 §2.9). At G12 thirty-one of thirty-four certify (§2.9, item 74). Obligation counts are each module's certified results file.

text.tspan: Nineteen proof modules, 10,586 obligations, no premise rows; ten under Proposed records

svg.text: Every property Labels, ToolList, Operators, Emergency, BreakGlass_A1, NonComposition_A1, Emergency_live and Coupling_live prove is outside the inventory: no row names what it rests on,
so the last column computes nothing for it, at the reference or for any deployment. Coupling_live's four leads-to properties are checked, not proved, and are not rows either.
Workflow and Mesh are proved and certified since 2026.11.11 (ADR-0054 R7, ADR-0055 R3: 1,136 and 1,470 obligations, 11 and 8 temporal steps by LS4; no state constraint), and the overlay's eight
since 2026.11.10 (ADR-0059 to ADR-0066 R1: 5,600 obligations). None has a row, every record is Proposed, and each record still owes its binding rows (G12 items 101, 112).
So T-0045-32 to 36, the five trusted-base rows Batch 34 added for the same records, are premises of no row (the matrix below draws their columns empty).
The record behind each of the eight is in force; two are provisional (ADR-0050, ADR-0052), so their properties would bind to text that is subject to redesign (ADR-0029 A4).
The rule space has bgScope : SUBSET BGActs, and Entry reads "R6" -> r.exceptions <= 2 and "R7" -> r.bgScope \cap AuthActs = {}.
ADR-0026 A2 (Batch 34, provisional with ADR-0052): R6's count is one, X1 being retired; R7 is read as "no activation of an emergency seating grants a lease whose alphabet holds an authority act" (G11
Anchor.tla and BreakGlass.tla extend it, so the rows FloorPreserved and BreakGlassNeverChangesAuthority rest on the old rule space. BreakGlass_A1 extends it too and reads bgScope for
nothing (its header). The ADR-0026 §6 rerun is still owed (G11 §2.1).

text.tspan: Two rows proved of modules that model X1, and one on R7 as first written

svg.text: NC1, NC2 (NonComposition.tla) and BreakGlassNeverChangesAuthority (BreakGlass.tla) are proved of predecessors that model X1, which is retired. Their successors, NonComposition_A1 and
BreakGlass_A1, are proved and certified and have no row; the predecessors stay frozen and cited by digest (G10 §3).
P7_BGNoAuthority is R7 as first written; A2 changed R7's subject.

Certified is not verified. It removes the SMT solver's soundness as a premise; the prover's translation, its normalization, LS4 and the checker stay trusted, and the translation is known to be unsound in
It changes no verdict in the last column: a proof is of the module, not of what runs (T-0045-28). Operators.tla and Emergency.tla are tied to the reference by tests and no refinement (item 90).

text.tspan: ): the proof column, and five corrections the proofs found

svg.text: Each proof module takes as hypothesis only the mutations that break each invariant, written independently of the table; where the two disagreed TLC agreed with the proof, and the table was corrected (G8 §3, result 2). The corrections' TLC rows are spec/premise-corrections-results-2026.10.02.txt (2669499135d2ea42), every outcome as predicted.
38 of 43 rows name a proof module: fifteen modules (thirteen at B25),
3,036 obligations (2,417 at B25), each invariant proved as Spec =>
[]P under the module's named assumptions and the absence of the
mutations that break it. At G12 there are 34 modules and 13,622
obligations, 31 certified (§2.9); the nineteen others have no row
(section 0).
No proof: effect exclusivity (a claim), PromotionMeetsIssuedQuorum
(module unwritten), Paxos.tla (the consensus log at the message
level, an operational model of the reference's replica, checked in
TLC, 27 rows in Paxos-results-2026.11.14.txt; no proof module,
because its safety argument is Voting's, ToO §11.3, not written as a
module: spec/proof-sync.sh) and PaxosTrace.tla (a trace
replay), the floor gates, and trace validation (Mechanism.tla is a
trace replay and ConfinementRefinement.tla a predicate set; the
target is the refinement, T-0045-28).
A proof of a module adds nothing at the reference (G10 §8),
certified or not: the last column moved at 2026.10.02 for the launcher,
not for the proofs.
M_OBSEMIT breaks none of the three invariants: it narrows an
observer's bound, and they are upper bounds.
ObserversConsultAndReport breaks under M_DOMAIN as well as
M_KIND.
TLC: rs-obsemit-safe holds; rs-mdomain-observer is a
counterexample.
M_OVERRIDE admits on a bundle allow whatever the floor said: it also
breaks FloorErrorIsDeny and BundleRefusalHonored.
M_ERR admits on an engine error: it also breaks
AdmitImpliesFloorPermit.
EnvelopeHolds is written out: M_WRITE, M_ERR, M_OVERRIDE. Three
new TLC rows, each a counterexample.
Breaks under M_EMITSEQ, not M_ROUNDS, which never touches a seal.
A transcription error: the results file's rows rc-emitseq-seal
(counterexample) and rc-rounds-seal (holds) already said so.
The five breakers stand. The lease's binding to its guest is enforced
by Act's generation check, which M_UNBOUND removes, and not by
SameGuest at grant, which the proof never uses.
A statement about the proof; no TLC row.

text.tspan: 5 · K < R struck as a premise

svg.text: UnreadBounded and UnreadEffectsBounded are proved for every K
and R; neither rests on K < R. TLC: both hold at K = 3 (and 5), R = 2.
ADR-0039 §1 keeps K < R so that condition 3 can refuse at all: a
non-vacuity claim, shown by the control rows (a backlog refusal is
reachable only when K < R).
Its hypothesis is R2 and (R1 or R9): under unanimity R2 makes the
counted approvers at least two; under a threshold R9 does; R2 is
needed either way.
The table read "drop R9 (binds only with R1 relaxed)"; it now adds "or
drop R2".

text.tspan: ): a Lean route beside the proof column, as derived premises

svg.text: Ratified 2026.10.06 in Batch 36: the table carries what follows. Counts are computed from spec/theorem-premise-binding.json at build time against the proof modules spec/lean re-encodes (H7).
32 of 43 rows name only proof modules spec/lean re-encodes: their *Checked in* column gains the Lean file, "proved in Lean in
spec/lean/TopakSpec/<M>.lean".
FloorComposition's rows also gain "the code's decision refines its Decide, in Lean" (mechanism/lean, ADR-0053 R2): its
invariants hold of every behaviour in which the code decides, on T-0045-3 at the module's size.
The floor gates' row gains floor/lean for totality, non-vacuity and discrimination, on the genesis floor and the floor in force.
Two proofs give a disjunction: a property holds if T-0045-31 holds, or if T-0045-37 holds and the encoding is the module. A derived
premise names it: invariant(M), an OR of AND-routes, still monotone, so excluding a premise only voids.
premise-routes-results-2026.11.03.txt, read at build time: 15 invariant(M), 2 encodings whose faithfulness is a check
on the graph check, and refines(Seats), T-0045-28 or the Lean stage. With T-0045-31 excluded and T-0045-37 trusted, 9 of 43
rows hold, where the binding before the merge said 38 (finding 13: no row named T-0045-31).

text.tspan: The one reference verdict whose reason changed

svg.text: Totality's holds° rows rested until Batch 36 on cedar's term folding, under T-0045-3. Proved in Lean of the genesis floor and the
floor in force (R3) under cedar-spec's model, they rest on T-0045-37 and T-0045-3's own premise, "the Cedar engine, as faithful
to the Lean model".
The verdict at the reference is unchanged: T-0045-3 is a trust root either way.
R1's precondition (ADR-0053): (a) the table states alternative sets, since the merge; (b) each refined encoding a named premise
with a check: Seats and FloorComposition have the graph check, eleven do not.
refines(Seats) is a route a deployment may declare, by declaring the Seats-shaped model faithful; no ADR-0033 addendum
cites it as a stage, and confirmation is required for it (ADR-0029 C4).

text.tspan: 2 · The full incidence matrix: 43 rows × 36 trusted-base rows, 16 parameters, 6 gaps, Proposed or stale premises and inputs, with the proof and certification columns

svg.text: Rows in the table's order, grouped by module. A column's chip and every dot in it carry the premise's class at the reference, so a void row shows the red dot that voids it. A large dot is a premise the row names; a ring is one it names only at a declared rung; a small grey dot is a BASE premise; a square is a parameter, gap or input premise. Uncited rows (T-0045-7, T-0045-26) are drawn so their absence shows, and so are T-0045-32 to 36, added at Batch 34 for modules the table has no rows for (item 90). T-0045-31, the

prover, is a BASE premise of the 38 proved rows only, for the invariant; T-0045-29 stays in every row's BASE for the mutations and witnesses. The struck K < R has no column. Chips follow Annex B: T-0045-19 and 20 have a rung-1 instance and 16 and 17 are SIMULATED (B29); T-0045-24 is excluded there although the reason ended with ADR-0033 A9 (item 89). The certification pill reads the proof modules a row names: a row is certified only if every one is.

text.tspan: Reading the last column as an inventory (the file's own words)

svg.text: At the reference, every theorem premised on confinement, gate evidence, hermeticity or channel fidelity is void; the routing theorem and the gate verdicts rest on checked proofs since 2026.10.01, where before they were the solver's assertion; the bundle's
revision is a file name; the reach bound is declared and not enforced.

What remains holds of the modules and, by trace validation, of the running code on every tested path: the lease, the fence, revocation, composition, the rules floor, the bootstrap pair, seats, any-of, coupling with its collusion gap, Run's counters and seal. That is
ADR-0045 Annex B's inventory sentence, computed.

text.tspan: Keeping it current, and where it is stale

svg.text: A new property adds a row; a new T-row or degeneracy adds a premise; an ADR-0033 addendum that changes a row's class at the reference changes the last column. tools/check-refs.py does not read this file.
A premise edge added into an existing theorem weakens it and needs its own record (ADR-0023 carried scope); the archetype-evolution record owns that rule (G10 item 7).

Stale as drawn: the inventory sentence still says "the bundle's revision is a file name" while its own BundleRefusalHonored row says the revision is verified since 2026.10.01, and calls every theorem premised on confinement void while FreshAppraisal now

holds at rung 1; "What this is not" says thirty-seven rows are proved, where 38 name a proof module; the trace row says 57 traces, 642 steps (Mechanism-trace-results-2026.10.02.txt), where G10 §3 records 82 traces, 1,007 steps (
Mechanism-trace-results-2026.10.05.txt, ADR-0033 A14), every step matching and every state keeping ConfinementRefinement.tla's invariants.
